note: `memberDid` must be a string — an administrator names one vetter, not an id of some other shape.
No `credentialId` selector. A member holds at most one live grant, and the community delivers that one.
No delivery address. The credential goes to the DID the grant names, never to one the request chooses.
No `validitySeconds`. A resend delivers the credential as issued; extending a grant is vtc/vetting/vetters/grant's business.
